component.name: Faultline
component.summary: Local-first Linux crash diagnosis and system forensics

description.p: Faultline examines systemd boot history, journals, coredump metadata, retained kernel crash records, and desktop errors to help explain Linux failures.
Findings keep supporting evidence and uncertainty visible. Collection runs as the current user and diagnostic data stays local.
Improve responsive window sizing and make enabled GNOME extensions easier to identify in the diagnostics view.
Refresh the native GTK dashboard and validate Fedora RPM and portable AppImage builds.
Prepare the Fedora 45 RPM and portable AppImage distribution.
First public release with portable AppImage packaging and Fedora RPM support.
